text:
anya: Quick check — bringing qbringup/v2 into staging exposed promptbank edgecases. We need to refresh the synthbank/golden subset and reroute a small batch to human labelers before we run quant4b smoke tests.
liam: what's the failure mode? quality regressions or tokenization mismatch?
sophia: saw hallucination spikes on few-shot longforms, also dedupe showed ~3% overlap with existing anchors.
anya: both — hallucination for long-context, and dedupe collisions + deid token spill. Want to run 500 samples through manual labelers (golden) and 2k automated checks.
devon: I can spin up a small annotation job — what's the sampling predicate? random long-context + rare-intent upsample?
anya: yes. predicate: length>1024 OR contains intent in [billing, legal, pii_ref]. also include 20% paraphrase-duplicates to validate dedupe.
maya: labelers are at 70% capacity this week. we can take 250 on Monday and 250 Wed. also suggest microgolden to sanity-check quant changes.
liam: can we auto-flag near-duplicates via embedding similarity first? run: python tools/near_dup.py --th 0.92 --embed-model qembed-1
labels-bot: annotation job created: JOB-5921, 250 units assigned to Team C (ETA 48h)
anya: perfect. devon, can you add the golden update note to the eval harness and pin seed? Put the promptset diff in /evals/prompt_diffs/1745500001.patch
devon: done. pushed patch and created canary rollout config:
```
canary:
  model: qbringup/v2-int4
  ratio: 0.05
  fallback: qbringup/v1
```
liam: will run dedupe pass and share overlap report by EOD.
sophia: linking the problematic examples here: https://internal/synthbank/17455 — please tag any PHI edgecases with #deid
anya: thanks all — ping me if labeler throughput changes. we'll hold the quant smoke until JOB-5921 is 50% complete :thumbsup:
